page.layout: Top: running head "PROMPTV. ICONVM" with page number 22 at left. Below it, two round medallion portraits side by side, with inscriptions around their rims (left: "F ISA." and "IACOB."; right: "RACHEL." and "LIA."). Below them, one column of running text in three paragraphs, with no margin notes. At the foot, a printer's ornament (not transcribed).

main_text.p: IACOB filius Isaac, fugiens fratrem Efau, ipse in Haran, ab auunculo Laban benignè ac hilariter exceptus est. cúmque menfem vnum apud eum cõmoratus effet, conuenit inter illos vt pro Rachel in vxorem habenda, seruiret Iacob ipsi Laban, patri Rachelis, septem annos: quibus exactis, Lia pro Rachele suppofita est: dolúsque consuetudine excusatus: nempe non-licere vt minor natu prænubat. Seruiit itaq; Iacob pro Rachele alios iterum septem annos. Sícque ambas sorores in vxores ha-buit: ex his ambabus, atque ex duabus ancillis, filios duodecim suftulit, ac filiam vnam. Natus est ei Ioseph ex Rachel, anno mundi 2200. ante Christum natum 1762. obiit diem annos natus 147. in Aegypto, vbi erat Ioseph, qui patrem accersiuerat durante sterilitate septé annorum. inde asportatus in Hebron, cum patribus sepultus est. Gen. 29. ca. & inde vsque ad calcem. Iosephus lib.r.cap.27.
LIA fuit vxor Iacob, cuius filij fuere Ruben, Simeon, Leui, Iuda, Iffachar, Zabulon, & Dina fæmella. Zelpha ancilla Liæ, peperit ipsi Iacob Gad, & Afer. Gene. 29. & 30. ca.
RACHEL quoque vxor Iacob fuit: huius filij fuere Io-seph & Beniamin, in cuius partu periit. Genef. 29. 30. & 35. cap. Balam ancilla Rachel, peperit item ipsi Iacob, Dan, & Neph-thalim.

page.notes: Numerals printed with wide spacing ("2 2 0 0", "1 7 6 2") are copied without spaces. The reference "lib.r.cap.27." has an Old-style numeral that may be a 1; it is copied as printed. The first line of the medallion inscriptions is read around the rim and may be incomplete. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
